subject: candidate line F5: runtime APIs are not readable inside a `use cache` function

variant.expectAnchor: Avoid rerender work only when there is a real changed path
text: - In a `use cache` function, take request data as arguments. Runtime APIs such as `cookies()`, `headers()`, and `searchParams` are not readable inside it.
